field.label: Enable Aliaser
field.help: Enable the Aliaser daemon to monitor and sync alias tables.

field.label: Default Interval (seconds)
field.help: Pre-filled check interval for new watchers, and the interval used when a watcher's own interval is left empty. Range: 10-3600 seconds.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Daemon logging verbosity. Error: errors only. Warning (default): failures, alerts and table changes. Info: also informational messages (e.g. nested alias re-merges). Debug: every check, including checks with no change.

field.label: Max Table Entries
field.help: Warn when any alias table exceeds this many entries. Set to 0 to disable.
